parsed.name: 质量流量控制器
parsed.description: 质量流量控制器（MFC）用于精确调节气体或液体的质量流量，常见于气体配比、工艺供气和实验流程控制。该驱动上下文显示可能覆盖多家厂商型号，厂商信息不唯一时保持空值。
parsed.description_en: A mass flow controller (MFC) is used to precisely regulate gas or liquid mass flow in gas mixing, process supply, and experimental control workflows. In this driver context, multiple vendor families may be supported, so manufacturer is left empty when not uniquely identifiable.

actions.description_en: Set the flow to its maximum value.

actions.description: 设置当前控制所用的气体类型。
actions.description_en: Set the active gas type used for flow control.
